title: Get through the gate
body: Tixr pass + matching photo ID. Collect badge, wristband and commemorative items. The floor opens at 9.

title: Ask at 201C
body: Review sessions run 2–5 p.m. Reserve early if you want one; places are first come, first served. Ask which slot fits your day.

title: Crafting Coziness & Creative Freedom
place: World of Warcraft · check official stage map
body: A promising creative detour: how a game makes room for people to feel at home. Suggested pick, not an obligation.

title: Scout the Classic Cup
body: StarCraft: Remastered and StarCraft II are part of the cross-game Classic Cup. Watch workers, the growing army, and the map. Ask: where will they go next?

title: Join the tiny green army
body: Emerald green is this year’s color. Stay for the fountain photo afterward if you feel like it. This overlaps the 11:45 World Building panel: choose your joy.

title: Lunch. Water. No agenda.
body: A good day has breathing room. The café at Inclusion Nexus is another place to recharge. Nothing to complete here.

title: One useful conversation
body: Bring your own questions or portfolio. Ask about appropriate pathways for Scholars; observing somebody else’s review requires permission.

title: Find the people behind the worlds
place: Inclusion Nexus · South Hall, second floor
body: Explore the stage, archives, community spaces and café. Introduce yourself, listen, and keep a follow-up only if it feels worthwhile.

title: Take the silly side quest
place: Darkmoon Faire · North Hall, second floor
body: Games, collectibles and a little wandering. No timer, no mandatory purchase. Let something unexpected catch you.

title: One last chorus?
body: Official Sunday live performance. Stay if you have the energy; leaving happy is also a good ending. Check the latest schedule before heading over.
